subject: MATHEMATICS
applicability_conditions: word context must be converted into one or more variable relations
use when the learner may already model correctly and should not be forced through unnecessary reteaching
anchor: Model by naming quantities first, then expressing each sentence as a relation among those quantities while preserving units and direction.
ordinary_language_bridge: Before solving, say what every symbol and whole expression means in the story.
reconstruction_route: translate one condition at a time

minimal_contrast.prediction_prompt: Why does the current add in one direction and subtract in the other?
minimal_contrast.decisive_feature: direction changes the effective-speed relation while variable meanings remain fixed

misconception_discriminator.candidate_wrong_model: equations are selected from keywords without preserving quantity meaning
misconception_discriminator.probe: remove all numbers and ask for variable/expression labels and relation directions
misconception_discriminator.decisive_response: learner constructs semantically correct relations before calculation

verification_method: replay each original journey/condition with solved values
